en.headline: 225,000 mainland visitors in by 4pm on Golden Week day one
en.dek: Immigration figures reported for Thursday afternoon put total crossings at about 601,000, with mainland arrivals already above Wednesday's full-day count.
body: About 225,261 mainland visitors had entered Hong Kong by 4pm on Thursday, the first day of the National Day Golden Week, according to Immigration Department figures reported by Sing Tao Daily. Arrivals of all kinds stood at 347,358, while 253,861 people left the city, about 192,000 of them Hong Kong residents. Combined two-way traffic was about 601,000.

The afternoon mainland total was already higher than the roughly 130,000 mainland arrivals recorded for the whole of Wednesday. By 10am on Thursday the department had logged 74,515 mainland arrivals and 112,153 arrivals overall, so most of the day's inbound flow built through the middle of the day.

Before the holiday the Immigration Department said it expected about 7.44 million crossings, residents and visitors together, through sea, land and air control points from 1 to 7 October. After talks with mainland border authorities it put land crossings at about 6.31 million, with the land outbound peak on Saturday and the inbound peak on Sunday.

Lo Wu, the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and Shenzhen Bay were expected to be the busiest land points, averaging about 220,000, 190,000 and 150,000 crossings a day. The MTR has added trains through 7 October, and the Transport Department has asked operators to run more shuttle buses at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and Lok Ma Chau.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日下午4時 逾22.5萬內地旅客入境
zh.dek: 入境處數字顯示，截至周四下午4時全市出入境約60.1萬人次，內地旅客入境已多過周三全日。
body: 國慶黃金周首日，入境處截至下午4時的數字經《星島日報》報道，已有225,261人次內地旅客入境。同段時間入境共347,358人次，出境253,861人次，當中香港居民約19.2萬。出入境合計約60.1萬人次。
下午的內地旅客數字，已高過周三全日約13萬的內地入境人次。周四上午10時，入境處錄得內地旅客74,515人次、入境合共112,153人次，顯示人流主要在日間累積。
假期前入境處估計，10月1日至7日經海、陸、空管制站進出本港約744萬人次，包括居民及訪客。與深圳邊檢等部門協商後，預計陸路約631萬人次，陸路出境高峰在周六，入境高峰在周日。
羅湖、落馬洲支線及深圳灣料最繁忙，每日平均約22萬、19萬及15萬人次。港鐵已加密列車至7日，運輸署亦協調港珠澳大橋及落馬洲皇崗穿梭巴士在高峰加密班次。
